tickets.title: Prepare charitable funding comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison for Nia Bramblequill of a securities gift, donor-advised account, and cash gift to Moonbadger Arts Foundation. Address taxable income, portfolio concentration, and cash retained for tuition and renovation spending. Reflect the household’s 10% single-company exposure guideline and the approximately $410,000 market value and $92,000 aggregate cost basis of Nia’s vested Apricot Compass Technologies RSU and ESPP shares.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare the comparison by December 12, 2025.

tickets.title: Verify Moonbadger Arts Foundation securities gift requirements
tickets.text: Verify Moonbadger Arts Foundation’s process for a large publicly traded securities gift, including delivery instructions, designation language for arts education, and the receipt wording needed for tax records.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to verify those requirements by December 9, 2025.

tickets.title: Prepare charitable deduction capacity projection
tickets.text: Prepare a tax projection for the Bramblequills’ charitable deduction capacity and possible carryforward. Account for compensation, unrealized gains, mortgage interest, and prior giving levels before a year-end transfer.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare that projection by December 17, 2025.
